semantics: Current sample word whose high byte serves as the Y-axis input of the 16x16 accessor families 00082c8a and 000befb0; in the crankshaft speed irregularity monitor classifier, ffff1024>>8 is compared with curves 0x1261a/0x1263a and enters the five-level ladder. The full unsigned word is also the numerator of calculated-load producer 0008083c: floor((ffff1024<<8)/lookup(0x1491a)). Scheduler 00020dfe copies the previous value to ffff1028 before refreshing ffff1024 from ffff1026.
note: The code proves the current/previous sample relation, axis roles, and calculated-load numerator role. The physical quantity and BFS scale remain unresolved.

semantics: New sample source copied by scheduler 00020dfe into current-sample word ffff1024 after the old current value is moved to previous-sample word ffff1028.
note: The rollover relation is proven by code. The physical quantity and producer of ffff1026 remain unresolved.

semantics: Previous sample of ffff1024. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff1024 here immediately before refreshing ffff1024 from ffff1026. In the ROM8[00008d92].bit3-clear branch of 00051a98, current minus previous is compared with ROM8[000087fd]<<3.
note: Stock JK08A has ROM8[00008d92].bit3 set, so the positive sample-delta comparison and its ffff1220 writer do not execute. The physical sample quantity remains unresolved.

semantics: Normal source of the Y-axis input for accessor 000bfdc0, selected when ffff2468 bit 3 is clear or ffff5773 bit 0 is clear; when both are set, 0xff is forced onto the upper Y-axis.
Output A of 1D-64 curve 0x14274. FUN_0003b520 combines it with B=ffff1056 to calculate byte contribution wA=uint8(trunc0((A<<8)/(A+B))).
Output B of 1D-64 curve 0x141F4. FUN_0003b520 combines it with A=ffff1054 to calculate byte contribution wB=uint8(trunc0((B<<8)/(A+B))).

Previous-cycle normalized engine-coolant-temperature index. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff1077 to ffff106f. In the linear range it is floor(1.6*(DID 0x1101 raw-10)), so lookup nodes 0,16,...240 represent -40,-30,...110 deg C.
note: DID 0x1101 returns ffff1079 and homologous diagnostic definitions identify it as engine coolant temperature with deg C = raw-50. FUN 00039634 performs the exact normalization and saturation.

semantics: Input of the misfire-monitor readiness curve 0x12DE2: the condition output(2*ffff1070) <= ffff1071, together with three related checks, sets bit 0 of ffff41d2.
note: The operational role is code-proven; the physical quantity and scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Quantity compared with calibration: in 0004d2a6 it carries ffff24a9 bit 3 hysteresis against ROM byte 0x8e03; in the event-count readiness gate it is compared with the output of curve 0x12DE2. The physical quantity is unidentified.

Current normalized engine-coolant-temperature index produced from ffff1079 by FUN 00039634: raw below 10 gives 0, raw from 10 through 169 gives floor(240*(raw-10)/150), and raw at least 170 gives 255.
note: The linear range maps -40 through 110 deg C to 0 through 240 in steps of 1.6 counts per deg C. Values at and above 120 deg C saturate to 255.

semantics: Exact one-byte response source for UDS DID 0x1101. FUN 0002c4f8 writes the converted sensor byte and then calls FUN 00039634 to form the normalized coolant lookup index.
note: Homologous diagnostic definitions identify DID 0x1101 as engine coolant temperature and define deg C = raw-50. The exact JK08A response pointer is ROM32[0x226b0] = ffff1079.

semantics: Signed load slope: the condition short[ffff10b8] < -byte[0x86AE] in 0005185c detects throttle release. With byte[0x86AE]=0, the threshold is zero, so any negative slope triggers detection.
Source of latch ffff1a78 (Q16 blend-weight input for 0x1488a in 00070e4c); in 00074c82 the same byte selects one of two component maps.
note: The axis claim for a physical quantity is refuted: the value comes from callers outside the component, while the axis unit is based on shape and catalog evidence (P6).

semantics: Second byte input of map pair 0xA8EA/0x9EDA through 0x26040 with implicit axes.
Previous-cycle coarse vehicle-speed byte. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff118e to this address; FUN 0004f324 requires it to equal zero before the stationary rev-limiter state can advance.
note: Exact firmware decodes CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5, filters the value through ffff113c/ffff115e, and FUN 0003a254 divides it by 20 into ffff118e. Homologous Z34 CAN data identifies this field as vehicle speed; the resulting byte uses approximately 2 km/h per count.

semantics: Packed hardware-input state assembled by FUN 00038618. Bit 2 reflects SH7058 port register PHDR bit 4 with active-low polarity and participates in the source condition for ffff2451 bit 2.
note: The MCU signal is pin 67/B19. The corresponding ECM terminal and physical switch name remain unresolved.

semantics: Coolant-conversion input byte. FUN 0002c4f8 obtains a 16-bit analog result through FUN 00028668(0), stores it at ffff1d60, shifts it right by two, and writes the low byte here. Calibration 00012dea converts this value into exact raw coolant response byte ffff1079; FUN 0008092e repeats the lookup for coolant snapshot byte ffff3fa4.
note: The coolant identity follows from the exact ffff1079 diagnostic response path, not from table shape.

semantics: Unsigned analog-derived state produced by FUN 00039a9e and compared with 100 while FUN 00038618 forms ffff2451 bit 2.
note: The source begins at SH7058 ADC channel AN0, pin 86/H17. The corresponding ECM terminal and physical sensor name remain unresolved.

semantics: Current coarse vehicle-speed byte written by FUN 0003a254 as min(255, ffff115e/20) and copied by scheduler 00020dfe to ffff110e.
note: The exact firmware source is CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5 through ffff113c and ffff115e. Homologous Z34 CAN data identifies the field as vehicle speed.

semantics: Shared 16-bit input of the 0x76xxx group (base ffff1114 + 0x3e): used as the lookup index in 000763e2 (shifted by >>3), 0007654c, and 00076770.
note: The meaning of the quantity has not been derived: all three consumers use it as an interpolation argument, and none exposes its source.

semantics: Absolutely addressed byte adjacent to structure ffff119c: its writer resolves through an xref, while no resolved writes exist anywhere in ffff119c..11b7 because that structure is populated by a handler through a pointer argument. The physical quantity is unresolved.
Base of the sensor structure populated through a pointer argument: no resolved write exists anywhere in ffff119c..ffff11b7, while adjacent absolutely addressed sensors are written normally.
note: 56,224 peripheral references versus 0 writes into the structure (ExportXrefs) explain why reference analysis cannot find the engine-speed writer.

semantics: Current engine speed. FUN 000384fe forms current byte ffff11e6 as min(255, ffff1196>>8), and scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff11ae. It is the shared axis input of the X-wrapper for the ignition, AFR-power, and lambda 16x16 families.
note: The rpm/50 unit converges across three independent RPM axes and the 7500 RPM cut. The common ffff1196 producer also establishes the exact relative RPM/25 and RPM/12.5 representations at ffff11b3 and ffff11f4.

semantics: Index for the base mode-selected maps of the angle summation (0x12196/0x1219e/0x121a6), read by wrapper 0x26370.
note: The base-map index and compensation index (ffff106f) differ; the cluster has no shared engine-speed axis.

semantics: Current engine-speed byte in RPM/25 representation. FUN 000384cc forms current byte ffff11eb as min(255, ffff1196>>7), and scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff11b3. FUN 0004fbe2 and FUN 00050018 compare it with the Over Run Fuel Cut and Restore table outputs.
note: The scale is code-derived relative to ffff11ae: both bytes originate at ffff1196, with shifts of 7 and 8 respectively.

semantics: Current rotational-speed coordinate used by the throttle-rev limiter. FUN 0007584e multiplies it by four and compares/rate-limits the result in the same raw domain as ROM16[0x942c].
note: The HR A2L scale for 0x942c implies 3.125 RPM per ffff11b6 count because the code multiplies the coordinate by four before comparison with a 0.78125 RPM/count scalar. Hardware validation remains required.

semantics: Current unsigned coordinate compared with the activation and release thresholds of engine-speed fuel-cut state machine 0004f282. Misfire reporter 00084cd0 retains it in three operating-point snapshot words, and matcher 000847dc compares the current value with each retained value inside a -30/+30 native-count window.
note: The public HR A2L scale x*12.5 RPM and the code/catalog conversion of the shared speed domain converge on RPM/12.5. Exact code does not contain the physical-unit division at this RAM location, so the RPM multiplier remains candidate.

semantics: Final signed ignition-timing coordinate written by FUN 0004dbe8. The calculation conditionally includes signed correction ffff12d6, applies additional limits and overrides, and is converted by FUN 0004df82 into the common response byte for UDS DIDs 0x1107 through 0x110A.
note: On the normal response path, FUN 0004df82 writes 110 - uint8[ffff11d4]. The community formula for DID 0x110A applies 110 - raw, so its displayed number equals this coordinate. The physical degree unit remains source-derived and special control modes use different response transforms.

semantics: Current engine-speed word in RPM/12.5 representation. FUN 000384fe writes ffff1196>>6 here. It is returned by UDS DID 0x1201 and is also an interpolation input for Fuel Compensation Map 0xA29A and the per-cylinder Knock Slice Map accessor 0x1108E.
note: The scale follows exactly from the common ffff1196 source: ffff11f4 is twice the RPM/25 value at ffff11b3 and four times the RPM/50 value at ffff11ae. This selects the x*12.5 community definition for DID 0x1201 over the conflicting x*10 definition.

semantics: Base of the RAM group containing six-channel pulse/update eligibility mask byte[ffff120e+0x12] at ffff1220.
note: The stock-mode writer is 00052034. FUN 00051a98 writes the mask only in the alternate ROM8[00008d92].bit3=0 path.

semantics: Six-channel pulse/update eligibility mask, addressed as ffff120e+0x12. In stock ROM8[00008d92].bit3=1 mode, 00052034 sets or clears each channel from ffff22e0, signed difference ffff142e, calibration 000087fe, and ffff16ff. FUN 00051a98 reads the prepared bit for a per-channel calculation, and 00051f1e passes the mask to one-shot scheduler 0002c13c.
note: This mask is not a standalone global fuel-enable state. Its exact physical pulse or update event remains unresolved.

semantics: Air/throttle target-calculation quantity (opening-area multipliers) in 000474a4, to which the lower bound max(uVar4, ffff171a<<3) is applied.
Gate enabling one term of the sum in 00054ee0.
Alternate unsigned 16-bit source selected by ffff245d bit 5 in per-channel difference producer 0005727a; when the bit is clear, ffff1024 is selected instead.
note: The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: One of the RAM sensor inputs of dual-channel interpolation accessor 0004bbee, alongside ffff119c/ffff2466; in 00051a98, byte[ffff128c+off] is a per-cylinder mask in the fuel-cut AND condition.

Signed subtractive ignition-timing correction written by FUN 0004d99c and conditionally added by FUN 0004dbe8 while forming ffff11d4. Map 0x147da supplies an interpolated amplitude; the function multiplies it by a selected byte coefficient, divides by 100, subtracts the quotient from an internal term, and clamps the result to [-128, 127].
note: The correction is active only when ffff24cc bit 1 is clear. The physical operating condition and the producer of map-axis input ffff237e remain unresolved.

semantics: Compensation sum of the angle summation: output of maps 0x11f0a/0x11f12/0x11f1a/0x11f22 indexed by ffff106f.
Base of the six-element signed 16-bit difference array written by 0005727a and compared by stock-mode mask writer 00052034 against ROM8[000087fe]<<7.
note: The physical unit is unresolved. ROM8[000087fe]=5 gives a comparison threshold of 640 raw counts.

semantics: 1D-16 variant selector in 000c0d90: 0x15b10 versus out-of-component 0x15ad0.
Angle-sum term from the base mode-selected maps, with a -0x80 bias applied to the result.
Output of the angle-summation adaptive-learn path, written under ffff248d bit 4; consumed by learn routine 0004e112.
Angle-sum term from 2D surface 0x9dba: two-bank read (ffff2442/ffff2443) through wrapper 0x26140, folded as (r1+r2-256)/2-128.
note: The double -128 offset (one -128 per bank) is the code evidence for an x-128 element.

semantics: Output of accessor 00055098: additive base ffff2ff0 plus the product of four byte multipliers >>12, saturated at 0xffff.
Blended output enabled by ffff24a2 bit 7; when the gate is clear the output is forced to neutral -128.
Output of dual-channel interpolation accessor 0004bbee.
Bits 0/1 form the combined condition enabling a sum term in 00054ee0 (0x4000 < ...).
Start of output group ffff1636..1638 in 0004d2a6; ffff2458 bit 5 selects their combination branch.

Unsigned readiness accumulator in fuel-output inhibit condition 0004f324. When timer ffff258a expires, the x-128 result of map 000124d2 is added with saturation to 0..65535. Readiness bit 4 of ffff247f is set when the accumulator is greater than or equal to ROM16[0000911c] and its secondary gate passes.
note: The stock readiness threshold is 381 counts. The physical meaning of the accumulator and exact duration of one timer count remain unresolved.

semantics: Measured signal compared with the diagnostic lower limit (map 0x12870) in a DTC monitor: while below the limit, debounce counter ffff1846 accumulates. The physical quantity is unknown.
Six-channel inhibit mask read by stock-mode ffff1220 writer 00052034. A set channel bit prevents the corresponding ffff1220 bit from being set.
note: The writer and physical origin of this mask are unresolved.

semantics: Output of floor curves 0x12908/0x12918 (00046938); consumer 000474a4 uses max(uVar4, ffff171a<<3) as the lower bound for ffff122a. The floor role is established by code, but the curve's own scale has not been derived.

Dynamic upper rotational-speed threshold in FUN 0007584e. Init routine 0002c648 copies ROM16[0x942c] here; the limiter then moves it toward the selected target with calibrated decrement/increment steps before calculating ffff19d8.

DTC-monitor debounce counter associated with limit map 0x12870: incrementing is enabled by ffff84c3 bit 6 and compared with threshold 0x8b71; upon reaching it, fault bit 0x04 is set in ffff24a1 and response 000b4ef8(0x2f) is called.

Six-channel fallback-history mask in ATU-II scheduler 0002c13c. A channel uses fallback word ffff23aa when its ffff22e0 bit is set or when the corresponding history bit is already set; selecting the fallback sets the history bit.

Shared signed request coordinate written by FUN 00079030 after applying mode-controlled bounds to the duplicated controller selection ffff2438/ffff19c2. FUN 00073432 adds numeric bias 0x8000 to recenter it as an unsigned interpolation key; FUN 00073628 uses the same coordinate in a parallel interpolation branch.
note: The sweep resolver treated 0x8000 as an axis; exact code shows a numeric bias. The continuous 0x942c path reaches this shared airflow/torque-request coordinate, not a proven bank-specific throttle-angle command or motor output.

semantics: Signed limiter candidate written by throttle-rev monitor 0007584e. ROM16[0x942c]=0xffff forces neutral 0x7fff; otherwise the monitor writes a bounded dynamic result. Arbiter 00071508 selects its minimum with other controller limits.
Signed limiter candidate written by adjacent calibrated branch 00075798 and selected by minimum arbiter 00071508.
Axis input of Q16 blend weight 0x1488a in 00070e4c: ffff10d2 latched under gate ffff417e bit 3. The physical quantity is unresolved.
Output after subtracting 4x4 trim 0xab4a from base map 0xb33a: clamp((0xb33a - 0xab4a) + 0x80) when ffff2466 bit 6=1, otherwise 0xb33a alone.
note: The 'Target AFR power' label for base 0xb33a is candidate: the link comes from base-map annotation, not from a trace.

semantics: One of three RAM inputs of reciprocal-transfer-pair component 0x72f1e (pairs {0x18e86,0x18fd6} and {0x18e46,0x18f96}); the write source is unidentified.
note: The missing source is why the pair members are downgraded to candidate: their reciprocal role is confirmed by the trace, but the physical quantity is not.

semantics: One of three RAM inputs of reciprocal-transfer-pair component 0x72f1e; the write source is unidentified.
Closed-loop throttle/airflow/torque variable: when ffff4246 bit 6 is clear, 0003b468 writes ffff3a76; when set, it writes ROM word 0x916c. FUN_0003b498 reads the result.
note: Eight component consumers confirm the loop, but they do not establish physical units.

semantics: Raw uint16 interpolation result of map 0x147da, written by FUN 0004d99c before coefficient multiplication and division by 100.
note: This transient value is an intermediate in the conditional correction that ends at ffff12d6; it is not the diagnostic response.

semantics: Common one-byte UDS response source for exact JK08A DIDs 0x1107, 0x1108, 0x1109, and 0x110A. All four entries in the 0x11xx pointer table address this byte. FUN 0004df82 normally writes 110 - uint8[ffff11d4].
note: The normal path aligns exactly with the community DID 0x110A display formula 110 - raw. Gated modes can add ROM8[0x8c95], subtract ROM8[0x83ea] with a cap from ROM8[0x864a], or force 110 - 20, so one affine formula does not describe every operating mode.

semantics: Bank 1 short-term fuel-trim word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 0005c910 normally copies working word ffff40ac here; an alternate control path forces a whole-percent value. UDS DID 0x1123 returns the high byte, while J1979 PID 0x06 returns min(255, floor(ffff22dc/200)).
note: Neutral is 0x6400 = 100 percent. The UDS community conversion raw-100 exposes signed correction percent from the high byte; fractional content is not returned by DID 0x1123.

semantics: Bank 2 short-term fuel-trim word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 0005c910 normally copies working word ffff40ae here; UDS DID 0x1124 returns the high byte and J1979 PID 0x08 converts the complete word by division by 200.
note: Neutral is 0x6400 = 100 percent. The bank mapping is established independently by standard PID 0x08 and exact UDS pointer data.

semantics: Bank 1 long-term fuel-trim diagnostic word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 00057b26 combines selected learned cell ffff2306 with adjustment ffff5648 around neutral 0x6400, applies limits and fail-safe neutralization, and writes this word. UDS DID 0x1125 returns its high byte; J1979 PID 0x07 converts the complete word.
note: The stock normal-path clamp is 90..110 percent from ROM bytes 0x8e5b and 0x8e5a. Other gates may bypass this clamp or force 100 percent.

semantics: Bank 2 long-term fuel-trim diagnostic word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 00057b26 combines selected learned cell ffff2308 with adjustment ffff564a and publishes the result to UDS DID 0x1126 and J1979 PID 0x09.
note: The representation, limits, and neutralization paths mirror bank 1 exactly.

semantics: Selected bank 1 cell from the 64-word learned-fuel-trim grid at ffff4b90. FUN 0005796c writes the selected Q8.8-percent value; FUN 00057d1e adapts the selected grid cell and FUN 00057b26 consumes this word when forming diagnostic LTFT.
note: Selection uses an 8x8 operating-region index; the physical name of its ffff1024 dimension remains unresolved.

semantics: Selected bank 2 cell from the 64-word learned-fuel-trim grid at ffff4b10. It is the bank-indexed companion of ffff2306 and enters the bank 2 LTFT diagnostic word.
note: The selector, update, bounds, and reset behavior mirror bank 1.

semantics: Working bank 1 closed-loop fuel-correction word written by FUN 0005cbec and copied by FUN 0005c910 to short-term fuel-trim diagnostic word ffff22dc on the normal path.
note: The output role and Q8.8-percent representation are exact; narrower names for the internal feedback terms in FUN 0005cbec remain unresolved.

semantics: Working bank 2 closed-loop fuel-correction word written by FUN 0005cbec and copied by FUN 0005c910 to ffff22de on the normal path.
note: The bank mapping follows the downstream standard PID and UDS paths.

semantics: Base of the 64-word bank 2 learned-fuel-trim RAM grid. FUN 0005796c selects one Q8.8-percent cell by an 8x8 operating-region index, and FUN 00057d1e updates selected cells with bounds 90..110 percent. Reset paths fill all cells with 0x6400.
note: This is adaptive RAM state, not a flash calibration table.

semantics: Base of the 64-word bank 1 learned-fuel-trim RAM grid. Its selection, update, bounds, and full-grid reset mirror bank 2.
note: This is adaptive RAM state, not a flash calibration table.

semantics: Bank 1 Q8.8-percent adjustment term maintained by FUN 00058168. FUN 00057b26 combines it with selected learned cell ffff2306 as ffff2306 + ffff5648 - 0x6400 when forming diagnostic LTFT ffff2302.
note: Fault paths force neutral 0x6400. The exact operating-mode name for this term remains unresolved.

semantics: Bank 2 companion of adjustment term ffff5648. It is maintained by the same bank-indexed function and combined with selected learned cell ffff2308 when forming ffff2304.
note: The arithmetic and neutral behavior mirror bank 1.

semantics: Six-channel aggregate output-inhibit/override mask written by 0004ed88. A nonzero global condition becomes 0x3f through 0004fb5e before additional per-channel masks are combined. FUN 00052034 blocks corresponding ffff1220 bits, while 0002c13c substitutes ffff23aa for corresponding scheduled channels.
note: Individual physical modes contributing to the aggregate are not all resolved.

semantics: Bits 0 and 1 form the combined gate for compensation 0x11f1a in the angle summation.
Unsigned Q15 multiplier used by per-channel difference producer 0005727a: the selected 16-bit source is multiplied by ffff22e6 and shifted right by 15 before uint16 saturation.
note: The physical meaning of the scaled value is unresolved.

semantics: Bits 0/1 gate sum terms in 00054ee0.
Bits 0 and 1 select the source for interpolation of inverse pair 0x13202/0x155a0 in wrapper 0003e548.
note: The selector role is established by code; the physical meaning of the selection is candidate.

semantics: Unsigned 16-bit fallback value selected per channel by ATU-II scheduler 0002c13c when ffff22e0 or ffff1935 contains the channel bit. If the channel start bit is already set, this value is also subtracted from the selected word before rescheduling.
note: The physical unit is unresolved.

semantics: First word of the six-channel compensated injection-pulse output written by FUN_0004eba2. UDS DID 0x1206 returns this word in big-endian order.
note: The VQ35HR factory manual identifies the corresponding monitor as actual compensated injection pulse width for bank 1. A homologous structured profile supplies scale raw/100 ms.

semantics: Second word of the six-channel compensated injection-pulse output written by FUN_0004eba2. UDS DID 0x1207 returns this word in big-endian order.
note: The VQ35HR factory manual identifies the corresponding monitor as actual compensated injection pulse width for bank 2. A homologous structured profile supplies scale raw/100 ms.

semantics: Signed ignition-angle sum: terms are base mode-selected maps through ffff1511, compensations through ffff12db, and 2D surface 0x9dba through ffff1514.
note: Code proves a signed angle quantity at this address; the 'degrees' unit and 'idle' qualifier come from catalog and vendor evidence (P6), so the subsystem semantics remain candidate.

semantics: Selected signed controller limit from minimum arbiter 00071508. It includes the throttle-rev candidate ffff19d8 and adjacent limiter candidate ffff19de, then enters closed-loop calculation 000702c6.
note: The exact physical output unit of the controller remains unresolved.

semantics: RAM interpolation input in 00073432: bias constant 0x8000 is added to recenter the value in the unsigned range and form a search key.
note: The pass resolver treated 0x8000 as an axis; the trace shows a numeric constant. It is not dereferenced as an array base, and the real axis arrives in r15 (discrepancy in Section 6).

semantics: First byte of the centered two-bank intake-cam timing pair. FUN_000bd9f0 writes clamp_u8(0x80 + ffff4799 - ffff22cc), or neutral 0x80 under the hardware-control mask. UDS DID 0x1135 returns this byte directly.
note: Homologous VQ35HR sources identify DID 0x1135 as intake valve timing bank 1. Community diagnostic definitions support candidate conversion raw*0.5-64 degCA; exact code proves the centered representation but not the physical scale.

semantics: Second byte of the centered two-bank intake-cam timing pair. FUN_000bd9f0 writes clamp_u8(0x80 + ffff479a - ffff22cd), or neutral 0x80 under the hardware-control mask.
note: The exact code proves the paired centered representation; bank-specific physical scaling remains a hardware-validation item.

semantics: Bit 2 selects the compensation branch (0x11f0a versus 0x11f12) in the angle summation and is an entry requirement for the fuel-output inhibit state machine 0004f324. Bit 1 selects a pair of curves (35..101 versus 27..122) in 000413cc; the same byte is also masked in the crankshaft speed irregularity monitor event-count readiness condition.

Bit 1 gates the differential-term contribution in 000413cc and helps select the map-read path in 0003c4a0 and 0002c59c. FUN 00038618 sets bit 2 when ffff1188 is at most 100 or ffff1164 bit 2 is clear; scheduler 00020dfe copies this current state to ffff244f, whose bit 2 is an entry condition for the stationary rev limiter.

Master gate used in seven components: bit 5 controls peak-hold and implicit map 0x12042 (00046938), selects the combination branch for outputs ffff1636..1638 (0004d2a6), and inhibits the fuel-output RPM state machine 0004f324. The byte is also a master enable in 0004fbe2, a correction enable for ffff170a in 00044500, a master gate for threshold latches ffff2492/ffff2493 in 0005525a, and one factor in the map-read condition in 00052be8.

Base of the decel/cut flag group: read by ten functions, with no resolved writes because the group is addressed by offsets from a loaded base (40 slots across the ROM). The angle-calculation range 0x82c8a..0x84436 contains none of these slots, ruling out a decel-gated branch in the angle summation.

Bit 5 selects the source used by per-channel difference producer 0005727a: set selects ffff123e, clear selects ffff1024. Bit 6 satisfies the secondary readiness clause of fuel-output inhibit state machine 0004f324 when ffff1071 is below ROM8[00008d0e]. The byte also participates in the ROM8[00008d92].bit3-clear calculation path of 00051a98.
note: Stock ROM8[00008d0e]=0 makes the unsigned ffff1071 comparison always true, so bit 6 cannot block readiness in JK08A. Bit 5 is a source selector in the stock per-channel path, not an identified Over Run Fuel Cut state.

semantics: Bit 6 gates application of multiplicative Q15 trim map 0x18d36 to the result of blend 0007a804.
note: The trim calibration is flat at 0x8000 (trim 1.0, no-op), but the branch is not dead.

semantics: Bit 7 gates bypassing interpolation in 0004b790.
Source of a calibration limit in 00062c68 together with ffff24c2.
Multipurpose calibration byte: sensor input for accessor 0004bbee; bit 6 enables subtractive trim 0xab4a in 000bfdc0; in component 00071448 (wave 4), it selects default 0x7fff.

Bit 3 selects the Y-axis input source in 0005594a and 000bfdc0: when clear, or when ffff5773 bit 0 is clear, normal source ffff102c is used; otherwise 0xff is forced onto the upper Y-axis. Bit 4 selects column 0 or 1 of engine-speed fuel-cut table 0000934e in 0004f282.
note: The public HR A2L catalog labels the two fuel-cut columns Normal and Reverse; exact code proves the two-way selection but not those physical mode labels.

semantics: Current accelerator-pedal high-state byte. FUN 00047a56 sets or clears bit 7 after comparing normalized dual-channel sample ffff266e with the selected threshold at 00008fdc/00008fde.
Bit 6 gates application of multiplier 0x12ede in 00055098.

Previous-cycle snapshot of ffff246a. Scheduler 00020dfe copies three bytes from ffff246a..ffff246c to ffff246d..ffff246f; bit 7 selects the release threshold 00008fde when the preceding accelerator-pedal high state was set and activation threshold 00008fdc when it was clear.
note: The current-to-previous copy closes exact activation/release hysteresis. This byte is not a rev-limit mode selector.

semantics: Result of comparison against a map output in 0005651c together with ffff2493.

Multipurpose status byte. In the fuel-output inhibit path, bits 3, 4, and 5 hold timer, readiness, and RPM-hysteresis state. In the EVAP purge-control circuit monitor, FUN 000acc54 controls bits 6 and 7; FUN 000abca2 consumes bit 7 as the exact P0443 dispatch condition and clears both result bits.
note: The byte is shared by independent state machines. ROM8[0x186D7].bit2 is clear, so the P0443 producer call and exact dispatch branch are skipped in stock JK08A. The physical scale of the EVAP circuit metric remains unresolved.

semantics: One of three factors in the map-read condition in 00052be8 together with ffff2458 and ffff249d.
Bit 4 selects special path 0x1230a in 00056bd0.
Bit 1 is a one-time init latch within the second sum term in 00054ee0.
Selector between a map path and constant 0x8000 in 0007173c.
Bit 4 gates the ignition-angle summation branch that writes ffff1513, consumed by routine 0x4e112.
